items.title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee accused of planting hidden recording device in conference room
items.summary: The FBI arrested a Saudi national who worked at OpenAI on the product team. The AI maker accused the employee of hiding a recording device in an executive conference room.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
items.summary: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Cambridge Heavy Industries has been quietly building a desktop fusion device
items.summary: Fusion power startup Cambridge Heavy Industries is building a small, laser-powered fusion device to fuel the coming wave of fusion power plants.
items.creator: Tim De Chant
